newsitem.title: USA: Computer Network to buy back 2 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Computer Network to buy back 2 mln shares.

text.p: Computer Network Technology Corp said Monday its directors have authorized the repurchase of up to two million of the company's 23.5 million common shares outstanding.
The purchases will be made from time to time in transactions on the Nasdaq National Market or otherwise.
Computer Network Technology said it had cash on-hand at 1996 year-end of about $35 million which will allow the company to maintain flexibility to fund its business growth.
"We believe the purchase of our stock represents a good use of resources," said Thomas Hudson, president and chief executive officer, in a statement.
Computer Network Technology designs and markets networking systems.
